generation.path: Hand-authored halanta/diacritic drift class, transcribed from specs/T-062-dialect-banks.yaml pan_regional_orthographic (rows गर्नुहोस and औषधी). Pan-regional only: neither row is a region claim, so this table runs at stage 1 for every speaker and waits on none of the T-062 native-speaker answers N1-N14. The inventory planned further orthographic classes (anusvara, visarga, chandrabindu, ZWJ/ZWNJ); none has an attested pair in a committed artifact, so none is authored here — an unfounded spelling rule is the black box D-2 forbids. The Devanagari digit fold (T-062 row ८ -> 8) is deliberately NOT an entry: it is a closed, total script map, implemented as the builtin DevanagariDigitTransform so that a table edit cannot disable it.

entries.note: T-062 basis: "halanta/visarga-level drift, not region". Both spellings already appear in the shipped keyword lists (औषधी खाएको छैन in the denial guard; औषधि खाएँ and औषधि खाए in the ack phrases), so the keyword-layer match set is identical on both sides and the medication-confirmation flow cannot flip.
